The bug was in the `gst()` function at invoicing/tax.py:11. It was using floating-point arithmetic:
```python
return int(amount_paise * rate_bp / 10000 + 0.5)
```

This can introduce precision errors, causing the off-by-a-paise issue for odd amounts. I fixed it to use the existing `round_half_even()` function which performs integer arithmetic:
```python
return round_half_even(amount_paise * rate_bp, 10000)
```

This approach eliminates floating-point precision errors and ensures accurate GST calculations for all amounts, including odd ones.
